### TaxCalculator {#type-commerz-pricing-calculation-contracts-taxcalculator}

`Commerz\Pricing\Calculation\Contracts\TaxCalculator`

Computes the tax on the discounted base of every line and of delivery. The built-in `rates` calculator reads the stored rates; a plugin contributes its own (an external tax engine, compound or origin-based rules).

```php
interface TaxCalculator {
    const KIND = 'tax_calculator';
    // Does not write and makes no network call inside the caller's transaction; time comes from the context.
    calculate(\Commerz\Pricing\Calculation\Data\TaxRequest $request): \Commerz\Pricing\Calculation\Data\TaxResult;
    // Contribution key, e.g. `rates` or `acme.avalara`.
    key(): string;
}
```

### TaxAmount {#type-commerz-pricing-calculation-data-taxamount}

`Commerz\Pricing\Calculation\Data\TaxAmount`

One tax computed for a requested item; the item's own `included` flag says whether it is part of the price.

```php
final readonly class TaxAmount {
    public readonly \Commerz\Money\Money $amount;
    public readonly string $code;
    public readonly ?string $lineId;
    public readonly \Commerz\Money\Rate $rate;
    public readonly \Commerz\Quotes\Enums\AdjustmentTarget $target;
    __construct(\Commerz\Quotes\Enums\AdjustmentTarget $target, ?string $lineId, string $code, \Commerz\Money\Rate $rate, \Commerz\Money\Money $amount);
    // Key of the item this tax belongs to; the same as `TaxableItem::key()`.
    itemKey(): string;
}
```

### TaxRequest {#type-commerz-pricing-calculation-data-taxrequest}

`Commerz\Pricing\Calculation\Data\TaxResult`

### PriceLists {#type-commerz-pricing-pricelists-contracts-pricelists}

`Commerz\Pricing\PriceLists\Contracts\PriceLists`

Price lists: a currency, a priority, a tax inclusion and the channels they serve.

```php
interface PriceLists {
    // Archiving an archived list changes nothing. @throws PriceListNotFound
    archive(\Commerz\Pricing\PriceLists\Data\ArchivePriceList $command): \Commerz\Pricing\PriceLists\Data\PriceListView;
    // Adds channels; one already assigned stays.
    assignChannels(\Commerz\Pricing\PriceLists\Data\AssignPriceListChannels $command): \Commerz\Pricing\PriceLists\Data\PriceListView;
    create(\Commerz\Pricing\PriceLists\Data\CreatePriceList $command): \Commerz\Pricing\PriceLists\Data\PriceListView;
    find(\Commerz\Pricing\PriceLists\Data\PriceListId $id): \Commerz\Pricing\PriceLists\Data\PriceListView;
    list(\Commerz\Pricing\PriceLists\Data\ListPriceLists $query): \Commerz\Pagination\Page;
    // Restoring an active list changes nothing. @throws PriceListNotFound
    restore(\Commerz\Pricing\PriceLists\Data\RestorePriceList $command): \Commerz\Pricing\PriceLists\Data\PriceListView;
    // Removes channels; one not assigned is ignored.
    unassignChannels(\Commerz\Pricing\PriceLists\Data\UnassignPriceListChannels $command): \Commerz\Pricing\PriceLists\Data\PriceListView;
    update(\Commerz\Pricing\PriceLists\Data\UpdatePriceList $command): \Commerz\Pricing\PriceLists\Data\PriceListView;
}
```

### Prices {#type-commerz-pricing-prices-contracts-prices}

`Commerz\Pricing\Prices\Contracts\Prices`

Prices of sellables: a currency amount per price list, customer group, quantity step and validity window.

```php
interface Prices {
    // Why a sellable costs what it costs: every candidate price with its verdict. Never throws for a missing price.
    explain(\Commerz\Pricing\Prices\Data\ExplainPrice $query): \Commerz\Pricing\Prices\Data\PriceExplanation;
    list(\Commerz\Pricing\Prices\Data\ListPrices $query): \Commerz\Pagination\Page;
    remove(\Commerz\Pricing\Prices\Data\RemovePrice $command): void;
    reschedule(\Commerz\Pricing\Prices\Data\ReschedulePrice $command): \Commerz\Pricing\Prices\Data\PriceView;
    // The `PriceResolver` port of the core on the price lists: the unit price of every request in the context's channel, currency, customer groups and moment (PRC-02). Reads only.
    resolveMany(array $requests, \Commerz\Context\CommerceContext $context): array;
    set(\Commerz\Pricing\Prices\Data\SetPrice $command): \Commerz\Pricing\Prices\Data\PriceView;
    // All or none. The views come in the order of the command.
    setMany(\Commerz\Pricing\Prices\Data\SetPrices $command): array;
}
```

### Taxes {#type-commerz-pricing-taxes-contracts-taxes}

`Commerz\Pricing\Taxes\Contracts\Taxes`

Tax classes, zones with their countries and regions, and rates with validity windows.

```php
interface Taxes {
    defineClass(\Commerz\Pricing\Taxes\Data\DefineTaxClass $command): \Commerz\Pricing\Taxes\Data\TaxClassView;
    defineZone(\Commerz\Pricing\Taxes\Data\DefineTaxZone $command): \Commerz\Pricing\Taxes\Data\TaxZoneView;
    listClasses(): array;
    listRates(\Commerz\Pricing\Taxes\Data\ListTaxRates $query): array;
    listZones(): array;
    // Removing a rate that is gone changes nothing.
    removeRate(\Commerz\Pricing\Taxes\Data\RemoveTaxRate $command): void;
    rescheduleRate(\Commerz\Pricing\Taxes\Data\RescheduleTaxRate $command): \Commerz\Pricing\Taxes\Data\TaxRateView;
    // Sets a rate; the same class, zone, tax code and window update it.
    setRate(\Commerz\Pricing\Taxes\Data\SetTaxRate $command): \Commerz\Pricing\Taxes\Data\TaxRateView;
    // Replaces the members of the zone.
    setZoneMembers(\Commerz\Pricing\Taxes\Data\SetTaxZoneMembers $command): \Commerz\Pricing\Taxes\Data\TaxZoneView;
    // The zone that taxes goods sent to the address: the region's own zone, else the country's; null outside all zones. What the built-in `rates` calculator uses.
    zoneFor(\Commerz\Ports\Delivery\Data\Address $address): ?\Commerz\Pricing\Taxes\Data\TaxZoneView;
}
```

### TaxRateNotFound {#type-commerz-pricing-taxes-exceptions-taxratenotfound}

`Commerz\Pricing\Taxes\Exceptions\TaxRateNotFound`

Either no rate of a tax class applies in a zone at the moment of a calculation (fail-closed: a missing rate is a configuration error, never a silent zero; a zero rate is set explicitly), or no rate has an id.

```php
    static forClass(string $taxClass, string $zone, string $at): self;
    static forId(string $id): self;
}
```
